data.title: Tameer — Facilities & Maintenance
data.short_description: An integrated platform for managing facilities, assets, and maintenance operations, bringing multiple sites, work orders, preventive maintenance, and team performance into one centralized system.
data.description:
Tameer is a digital platform that helps companies and facilities management teams coordinate operations and maintenance across multiple sites. It connects locations, buildings, assets, and teams, allowing maintenance requests to be tracked from initial reporting and technician assignment through execution, review, and closure.

The platform combines preventive maintenance scheduling, corrective work orders, service level tracking, incident documentation, and work permit requirements. Reports and performance indicators give management clearer visibility into asset condition, work progress, and team performance.
data.challenge:
Managing facilities becomes difficult when asset records and maintenance activities are spread across separate files and communication channels. As the number of sites and teams grows, assigning responsibility, tracking overdue requests, and keeping up with scheduled maintenance become increasingly challenging.

Without a unified maintenance history and clear performance indicators, management has limited visibility into service quality and fewer reliable insights to support operational decisions.
data.solution:
Tameer centralizes facilities data and maintenance workflows, connecting each request to its location, asset, and responsible team. It provides a structured work order lifecycle, automatically generates preventive maintenance work orders according to configured schedules, and tracks response and resolution targets.

Through maintenance records, notifications, and reporting, the platform helps organize daily operations, reduce manual follow-ups, and improve coordination between managers, supervisors, and technicians.

key_features.title: Company Management
points: Create, view, update, and delete companies.
Filter and search companies, view their statistics, and export their data.
Manage client information, contact details, and procurement and back-office email addresses.
Configure notification and security settings for each company.

key_features.title: Site Management
points: Create, view, update, delete, and deactivate sites.
Link sites to companies and assign a manager to each site.
Store site details, working hours, and geographic information.
Select a user's current site and scope data to sites they can access.
Download a site template, bulk import sites, and export site data, including a full site data export.

key_features.title: Location Hierarchy
points: Manage zones, buildings, floors, and units within sites.
Browse a building's floors and units and the units on each floor.
Import buildings, floors, and units using downloadable templates.
Validate the site, building, floor, and unit hierarchy when creating work orders.

key_features.title: Users and Teams
points: Create users, view their profiles, update their details, and delete them.
Assign users to one or more sites and departments, and remove site assignments.
Activate or suspend users, including bulk activation.
List technicians and view user statistics and related work order performance.
Manage departments and assign users to them.

key_features.title: Accounts and Security
points: Register accounts and sign in and out through API sessions.
View and update profiles, change passwords, and delete accounts.
Reset forgotten passwords using an email verification code.
Send and verify two-factor authentication codes, with a company setting to require them.
View account security status and revoke active sessions.
Control access by role, view role permissions, and update permission assignments.

key_features.title: Assets and Categories
points: Register, view, update, delete, and filter assets by site, status, and category.
Manage hierarchical asset categories and search through child categories.
Generate asset serial numbers associated with their site and category.
Generate and download asset QR codes, and scan them to view asset details and maintenance schedules.
Show the scanning technician's assigned open work order for the asset.
View an asset's related preventive maintenance plans and asset statistics.
Upload asset images and files individually or in bulk.
Download an asset template, bulk import assets, and export asset data.

key_features.title: Preventive Maintenance Plans
points: Create, view, update, delete, and renew preventive maintenance plans.
Set daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly plan frequencies.
Set start dates, next due dates, estimated durations, and assignment windows.
Link plans to multiple assets and checklists and list suitable technicians.
View plan statistics, download a template, and import or export plans.
Automatically generate preventive work orders from due plans through a daily scheduled job.

key_features.title: Checklists and Maintenance Tasks
points: Create, view, update, and delete checklists linked to assets and maintenance plans.
Organize checklist tasks into manageable, ordered groups.
Create, update, and delete maintenance tasks and define their details.
View checklist statistics and filter eligible assets.
Download and import checklist and maintenance task templates, and export checklists.

key_features.title: Open Preventive Work Orders
points: View open preventive work orders with their related plan, asset, and task details.
Filter orders by status, frequency, date, location, service class, and spare parts, with text search.
Assign a preventive work order to a technician with an assignment deadline.
Assign or delete multiple preventive work orders in one authorized action.
Put a preventive work order on hold with a reason and remarks, then resume it.
Complete the order after checklist tasks are done and a photo is attached, with optional notes.
View preventive work order statistics and export their data.

key_features.title: Corrective Work Orders
points: Create corrective requests linked to a site, location, department, asset, service type, and priority.
Attach photos and descriptions and record an external request source when creating a request.
List, search, filter, view, update, and delete corrective requests.
Assign and reassign requests to technicians and record assignment and status history.
Manage response, start, hold, resume, completion, review, and closure stages.
Return a request to the same technician with remarks when more work is needed.
View corrective request statistics and technicians available for assignment.

key_features.title: Service Level Agreements
points: Configure response and resolution targets by site, service type, and priority.
Calculate response and resolution deadlines when corrective requests are created, using site working hours.
Pause SLA time while a request is on hold and extend deadlines when work resumes.
Show active work time, frozen time, and response and resolution SLA performance.
Use SLA results in dashboards, reports, and site and technician statistics.

key_features.title: Work Execution and Spare Parts
points: View a technician's assigned work orders, statistics, and performance metrics.
View work order tasks, complete them, update task results, or undo completion.
Add, update, and remove spare parts used on a work order and link them to its asset.
Create and view spare parts requests for corrective work orders.
Save work photos, notes, and status history during order execution.

key_features.title: Incidents
points: Record, view, update, delete, and track incidents.
Record incident classification, severity, location, time, affected people, and witnesses.
Document immediate actions, contributing factors, notes, and escalation needs.
Attach incident media and submit a simplified incident report from mobile.
View incident statistics, download a template, and import or export incidents.

key_features.title: Work Permits and Safety
points: Create, view, update, and delete work permits and safety checklists.
Set safety categories, work types, required tasks, and task order.
Link assets to permits, add or remove them, or synchronize the asset list.
Manage reusable work permit task templates separately.
View permit statistics, download and import permit and task templates, and export permits.

key_features.title: Dashboards
points: View a main dashboard with work order KPIs, status cards, and card details.
See SLA compliance trends and request source and urgency distributions.
Filter dashboard metrics by authorized company, site, and date range.
Use a site manager dashboard with work summaries and analytics.
Use a supervisor dashboard with tasks, team members, task details, and performance analytics.
Use a mobile dashboard showing order totals, statuses, monthly trends, and site performance.

key_features.title: Reports and Analytics
points: Analyze request totals, completion rate, average response time, and SLA compliance.
View monthly performance trends, site comparisons, priority distribution, and resolution times.
Analyze performance by service type and identify top-performing technicians.
Filter analytics by company, site, department, work order type, and date range.
Access mobile reports for monthly operations, asset performance, and team productivity.
Identify assets with the most work orders and measure completion by site and technician.

key_features.title: Notifications
points: View notifications and details, count unread items, and mark them as read.
Send notifications for work order creation and related events.
Support real-time, email, and registered-device notifications.
Register and remove user device tokens for mobile notifications.
Configure notification channels, alerts, and report summaries at company and site level.
Send scheduled daily summaries and weekly reports to managers when enabled.

key_features.title: Import and Export
points: Provide import templates for sites, buildings, floors, units, assets, plans, checklists, tasks, incidents, and permits.
Process large imports in batches and track batch status and results.
Export available operational data in spreadsheet formats.
Run large exports in the background, track progress, and download the resulting file.
Scope imports and exports to sites the user is authorized to access.

key_features.title: Files and Media
points: Upload one or multiple files through the API before attaching them to records.
Attach images and files to assets, incidents, and work orders.
Store uploaded files temporarily before attaching them to the relevant record.

key_features.title: System Logs and Governance
points: Record important system activity and view system log lists and details.
Keep a history of work order status changes and assignments.
Apply granular permissions to management modules and sensitive operations.
Isolate site data according to user membership and permissions.

related_projects.title: Multi-Vendor Salon & Beauty Booking Platform
related_projects.short_description: A multi-vendor beauty platform connecting salons, independent professionals, and customers. Users can discover services and products, book appointments, shop online, and use offers, while administrators manage operations, orders, and payments.
related_projects.description: A complete marketplace for salon and beauty services. Customers can browse salons and independent professionals by city and category, review profiles and ratings, select a service or package and an available time slot, then book an appointment or place a product order. The platform includes management of salons, specialists, freelancers, services, packages, products, stock, offers, and orders. The admin dashboard covers bookings, sales statistics, users, content, commissions, payments, inquiries, and complaints. The project includes a customer web interface, an admin dashboard, and an API for customer and provider apps.
related_projects.challenge: Managing multiple salons, independent professionals, and their products in one system while coordinating availability, tracking bookings and orders, and giving customers a clear experience across locations and providers.
related_projects.solution: A unified platform that connects service and product discovery with booking, shopping, payment, and order tracking. It provides a customer experience, provider tools for services and orders, and a central dashboard for content, operations, and reporting.

related_projects.title: Nusk Al-Umrah
related_projects.short_description: An integrated digital platform for managing and booking Umrah and Hajj packages, including a web portal, admin dashboard, and mobile app connecting customers, agents, and management in one unified system.
related_projects.description: Nusk Al-Umrah is a comprehensive platform for religious tourism companies, enabling the creation of Umrah and Hajj packages composed of hotels, apartments, ground and air transport, meals, and additional services. It delivers a seamless booking experience for customers via the website or mobile app, alongside a powerful admin dashboard covering bookings, users, agents, and financial reporting.
related_projects.challenge: Umrah and Hajj travel agencies often rely on fragmented, manual operations: phone or spreadsheet-based bookings, disconnected hotel and transport inventory, difficulty tracking agent commissions, and no unified digital customer experience. This leads to operational errors, slower service, and challenges in scaling and data management.
related_projects.solution: A unified multi-channel platform that centralizes all booking and management operations: customers browse and book packages via web or mobile, agents manage their bookings and commissions through a dedicated portal, and administrators control inventory, packages, bookings, and users from a central dashboard with real-time statistics and automated PDF invoicing.

related_projects.title: Esharb
related_projects.short_description: Esharb is a bilingual (Arabic/English) e-commerce catalog platform for premium hijabs and scarves, with an API-powered admin backend for products, inventory, and customer inquiries.
related_projects.description:
Esharb is an end-to-end catalog system for modest fashion products (hijabs, scarves, and accessories), combining a modern, responsive storefront

Built for the Egyptian and MENA market, the platform offers full Arabic/RTL support, EGP pricing, and direct WhatsApp integration to turn inquiries into sales. Customers can browse products by category, material, color, and price, with rich product pages featuring image galleries and color variants. The operations team manages everything from products and banners to static pages, inventory tracking, and role-based access control.
related_projects.challenge:
Many hijab and scarf retailers in the region rely solely on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, without a professional website to showcase products systematically. This leads to:

Difficulty displaying products with multiple colors and materials
Lost inquiries scattered across social media messages
No inventory system or stock tracking
Poor search engine visibility (SEO)
Challenges managing bilingual content (Arabic & English)
No clear role-based access for team members
related_projects.solution:
We built Esharb as an integrated solution combining:

An elegant e-commerce storefront with a modern design reflecting a premium brand identity
A smart product catalog with variants (colors, prices, images), advanced filtering, and search
WhatsApp integration for auto-generated product inquiries with full details
An API-powered admin panel to manage products, categories, banners, pages, FAQs, and settings
Inventory management for stock quantities and movement tracking
Role-based permissions (Super Admin / Admin) to secure operations
SEO optimization via Sitemap, Meta Tags, and Structured Data

key_features.title: Storefront
points: Bilingual interface (Arabic/English) with RTL support
Homepage with banners, featured, new arrivals & best sellers
Product catalog with filters (category, material, color, price, availability) & sorting
Product page with image gallery, color picker & price variants
Product categories with dedicated pages
Advanced search across products & categories
WhatsApp inquiry with auto-generated message
Contact form with inquiry tracking
Static pages (About, Contact, FAQ)
SEO optimization (Sitemap, Meta, Open Graph, Schema)
Responsive design (Mobile-First)

key_features.title: Admin Panel
points: Product management (CRUD + soft delete restore)
Categories, materials & colors management
Promotional banners management
Pages & FAQs management
General settings (brand name, WhatsApp, SEO)
Inventory system with movement tracking & low-stock alerts
Inquiries & messages management
Users, roles & permissions management
File & image upload management
Dashboard stats (products, inventory, users, inquiries)
